nodes.description: Immutable IRibbonFactory used to resolve protocol adapters by venue name.
Immutable IProtocolAdapter (HEGIC) that receives delegatecalls for purchase/exercise/profit.
Immutable IAmmAdapter used via delegateBuyLp to add liquidity.
Immutable Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface oracle for current price.
Payable address of the AMM adapter used as delegatecall target.
Mapping of account to array of InstrumentPosition records; core storage mutated by buy and exercise flows.
Immutable address of the Hegic wBTC options contract.
Immutable wBTC token address used as underlying/strike/collateral.
Immutable underlying asset of the option terms.
Immutable strike asset of the option terms.
Immutable collateral asset of the option terms.
Immutable resolved adapter address stored during construction.
Constructor validating non-zero addresses and wiring immutable dependencies including factory adapter lookup.
Reads latestRoundData from the Chainlink oracle and scales it to 1e18.
View that computes wbtc size, digg out, premium and total cost, using block.timestamp to derive expiry.
Payable entry point: delegatecalls AMM adapter to add liquidity, buys put, then refunds leftover ETH to msg.sender.
Non-reentrant function that reads stored position, queries exercise profit and delegatecalls adapter exercise then marks exercised.
View returning the profit for a given account position via adapter staticcall.
View checking whether a stored position can be exercised.
Non-reentrant payable that validates expiry against block.timestamp, delegatecalls adapter purchase and records the position.
msg.sender used as recipient of leftover ETH refund in buyInstrument.
block.timestamp used to compute option expiry inside getInputs.
msg.sender used to index instrumentPositions and as exercise profit recipient.
block.timestamp compared against params.expiry to gate purchase.
delegatecall to the AMM adapter executing buyLp in this contract's storage context.
delegatecall to the protocol adapter executing exercise.
delegatecall to the protocol adapter executing purchase.
Low-level ETH transfer of residual balance to msg.sender at the end of buyInstrument.
External oracle call to priceProvider.latestRoundData() whose result is trusted without staleness checks.
Staticcall to the protocol adapter executing exerciseProfit.
BuyInstrumentParams calldata supplying lpAmt, tradeAmt and min-out bounds.
BuyInstrumentParams calldata supplying expiry, strike, amount and max cost.
Index into the caller's instrumentPositions array.
Account whose position profit is queried.
Position index queried for profit.
Account whose position exercisability is queried.
Position index checked for exercisability.
ETH amount input used to size wbtc and digg exposure.
Storage reference to the caller's InstrumentPosition being exercised.
Extracted putOptionID used for exercise calls.
Profit returned from the adapter exercise-profit query.
Computed wBTC size from expectedWbtcOut.
Expiry computed as block.timestamp plus timePeriod.
OptionTerms struct assembled from params and passed to delegatePurchase.

getInputs calls adapter.premium to compute cost.

Local wbtcSize used within getInputs computation.
Local expiry used within getInputs computation.

msg.sender is the recipient of the residual ETH refund.

Local profit from the adapter accumulates into totalProfit.

optionsAddress is passed to the profit query.
Caller context is used for position lookups in the related path.

positionID param selects the position for the view.

adapter is delegatecalled to purchase the option.

Position index parameter is used only inside the exerciseProfit core view function.
